# vastdata_de_container_registry (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Register a container registry with Data Engine and bind it to a Kubernetes cluster.
# Requires vastdata_de_engine, mTLS credentials, and a kubernetes cluster resource.

provider "vastdata" {
  host     = "vast-cluster"
  username = "admin"
  password = "******"
  # tenant = "de-lab"
}

resource "vastdata_de_mtls_authentication_credential" "example" {
  name            = "de-mtls"
  tenant_name     = "de-lab" # required for cluster-admin auth
  kubeconfig_data = file("${path.module}/kubeconfig")
  context_name    = "my-cluster-context"
}

resource "vastdata_de_kubernetes_cluster" "example" {
  name                  = "de-test"
  tenant_name           = "de-lab"
  kube_api_url          = "https://k8s-api.example.com:6443"
  mtls_credentials_guid = vastdata_de_mtls_authentication_credential.example.guid
  namespaces = [
    "default",
    "istio-system",
    "vast-dataengine",
    "vast-pipelines",
  ]
}

resource "vastdata_de_container_registry" "example" {
  name        = "de-registry"
  tenant_name = "de-lab"
  url         = "https://registry.example.com"
  auth_type   = "none"

  # Exactly one of kubernetes_cluster_vrn or kubernetes_cluster_name.
  primary_kubernetes_cluster = {
    kubernetes_cluster_name = vastdata_de_kubernetes_cluster.example.name
    namespace               = "default"
  }

  additional_kubernetes_clusters = [
    for ns in setsubtract(toset(vastdata_de_kubernetes_cluster.example.namespaces), toset(["default"])) : {
      # Same one-of: vrn (shown) or kubernetes_cluster_name.
      kubernetes_cluster_vrn = vastdata_de_kubernetes_cluster.example.vrn
      namespace              = ns
    }
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A name for the resource.
- `primary_kubernetes_cluster` (Attributes) Primary Kubernetes cluster and namespace for the container registry. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--primary_kubernetes_cluster))
- `url` (String) URL to the container registry.

### Optional

- `additional_kubernetes_clusters` (Attributes Set) Additional Kubernetes clusters and namespaces where the container registry is replicated. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--additional_kubernetes_clusters))
- `auth_type` (String) Flag indincating login to the container registry requires user and password, secret name, or none
- `description` (String) A description of the resource.
- `email` (String) User email for logging in the container registry
- `is_accessible_to_data_engine` (Boolean) When true (default), the Data Engine will periodically validate that the container registry and its images are accessible. Set to false if the registry is not reachable from the Data Engine (e.g., ECR with IRSA).
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for logging in the container registry
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret name for logging in the container registry
- `tags` (Set of String) Custom tags for organizing and categorizing resources in the GUI.
- `tenant_name` (String) Tenant name for Data Engine API queries. Required for cluster-admin auth; optional when the provider already authenticates as that tenant.
- `username` (String) Username for logging in the container registry

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was created.
- `guid` (String) A globally unique identifier (GUID) for the resource.
- `id` (Number) A globally unique identifier (ID) for the resource.
- `owner` (Attributes) Represents the owner of the resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner))
- `tenant_guid` (String) A globally unique identifier (GUID) for the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was last updated.
- `vrn` (String) A logical path for resource grouping and policy assignment. The structure of the logical path is: vast:dataengine:<resource type>:<custom structure per type>
where resource type is one of: triggers / functions / pipelines / topics / kubernetes-clusters / container-registries / mtls-authentication-credentials.
